def transform3(g):
    H, W = len(g), len(g[0])
    flat = Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    fill = flat.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def rowline(r):
        c = Counter(g[r]); v, n = c.most_common(1)[0]
        return v if v != fill and n >= 0.6 * W else None
    def colline(c):
        col = Counter(g[r][c] for r in range(H)); v, n = col.most_common(1)[0]
        return v if v != fill and n >= 0.6 * H else None
    hlines = [r for r in range(H) if rowline(r) is not None]
    vlines = [c for c in range(W) if colline(c) is not None]
    L = rowline(hlines[0])
    marks = {}
    for r in hlines:
        for c in vlines:
            v = g[r][c]
            if v != L and v != fill:
                marks[(r, c)] = v
    mh = sorted({r for r, c in marks}); mv = sorted({c for r, c in marks})
    hseg = hlines[hlines.index(mh[0]):hlines.index(mh[-1]) + 1]   # span incl. unmarked
    vseg = vlines[vlines.index(mv[0]):vlines.index(mv[-1]) + 1]
